cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-26: a launch or issue by the ministry is not adoption (messages-for-bill 132). The strategy was handed to the Prime Minister for adoption in March 2025, no government adoption is reported, and in November 2026 a 2026-2030 strategy was being drafted, so stage 2.
